10 استفذّبِهِ He was, or became, alone; inde
pendent of others; without any to share, or participate, with him; in it: (K, TA:) you say, استفذّ عَلَىَّ بِاالأَمْرِ He was, or became, alone, or independent, exclusively of me, in the affair: (O:) and بِهِ ↓ تفذّذ also has the former meaning: (K, TA:) or this latter signifies He was, or became, alone with him. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
